title: GRAM: Group-wise Rank-Aware Model Merging via Subspace Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.29110v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Merging different models into a single model is highly desirable for multi-task deployment, particularly in regulated domains like healthcare. In such settings, models are often locally fine-tuned due to strict data privacy policies, necessitating that aggregation operates exclusively on the fine-tuned weights. Existing methods apply a uniform merge across all tasks, ignoring the geometric relationships among their learned subspaces. When task updates occupy misaligned subspaces, projecting them onto a shared low-rank basis discards task-relevant directions, a failure mode named \emph{subspace interference}. Through this study, we show that the per-task projection error of a merged model is governed by the principal-angle alignment between each task and the shared subspace, so that grouping geometrically compatible tasks provably reduces this error within each group. translated_title: GRAM：基于子空间对齐的分组秩感知模型合并
translated_abstract: 将不同的模型合并为单一模型对于多任务部署而言极具价值，尤其是在医疗保健等受监管领域。在这类场景中，由于严格的数据隐私政策，模型通常只能在本地进行微调，这要求聚合操作仅基于微调后的权重进行。现有方法对所有任务采用统一的合并方式，忽视了各任务所学子空间之间的几何关系。当任务更新位于未对齐的子空间时，将其投影到共享的低秩基上会丢弃与任务相关的方向，这种失败模式被称为“子空间干扰”。通过本研究，我们证明了合并模型中每个任务的投影误差由该任务与共享子空间之间的主角度对齐程度所决定，因此将几何上兼容的任务进行分组可以在每个组内可证明地降低该误差。受此观察启发，我们提出了分组秩感知模型合并方法（GRAM）……
tldr: 提出GRAM方法，通过主角度对齐分析将几何兼容的任务分组，并在组内进行秩感知的子空间对齐合并，可证明地降低投影误差，从而解决模型合并中的子空间干扰问题。
en_tdlr: GRAM groups geometrically compatible tasks based on principal-angle subspace alignment and performs group-wise rank-aware merging, provably reducing projection error to mitigate subspace interference in model merging.
